 Black Friday Skincare Deals: Take up to 42% Off Our Favorite Beauty Award Winners 
 Save on editor-approved skincare tools, body care, and face products for less.
 By Nicole Saunders Published: Nov 10, 2026 6:00 AM EST Save Article Share Article Medicube Women's Health may earn commission from the links on this page, but we only feature products we believe in. Why Trust Us? 
 4 min read Black Friday falls on November 27, but as our deals-obsessed beauty editor, I’ve already spotted noteworthy skincare sales that I’m shopping early.
 These Black Friday deals include face mists, cleansers, and toners (oh my!) made with dermatologist-approved ingredients to target zits, skin radiance, and hydration. Think salicylic acid to treat acne and peptides to help rev up the production of collagen for more youthful-looking skin. There are also epic early savings on beauty tools, including LED masks, microcurrent tools, and laser hair removal devices.
 SHOP BLACK FRIDAY SKINCARE DEALS 
 The best part: Every included product was recently featured in our Beauty Awards or Skincare Awards . For Beauty Awards, beauty director Brian Underwood and I tapped 14 experts. For Skincare Awards, we also consulted dermatologists, cosmetic chemists, estheticians, and makeup artists about the latest and greatest products. Collectively, our team of experts vetted thousands of products. Underwood and I also have more than 30 years of beauty journalism and product testing experience to deliver to you our no-filter takes on the skincare products actually worth your hard-earned money this Black Friday.
 Black Friday Skincare Deals: Best Beauty Tools
 We’re in a renaissance of beauty gadgets. Nood’s IPL Laser Hair Removal Device ensures waxing is a thing of the past. It uses intense pulsed light therapy (IPL) to reduce hair growth over several weeks. Plus, it’s equipped with a larger window and emits continuous flashes so you can polish off your legs in 15 to 20 minutes.
 Korean beauty brands have earned plenty of hype for innovative formulations and high-tech capabilities. Our favorite microcurrent device is the six-in-one Medicube. “Once I committed to using this one, I got results,” says makeup artist and content creator Erica Taylor in our Beauty Awards . “Now, it’s a daily ritual. It really enhances absorption of my topical products and improved my skin tone notably." I use mine to help sculpt my cheekbones with microcurrent technology.
 SHOP BLACK FRIDAY SKINCARE DEALS 
 Solawave is also offering a buy one get one free deal if you purchase directly from the brand. In just three minutes, Solawave’s LED neck mask emits a powerful blend of four wavelengths—red, near-infrared, deep red, and amber—to smooth lines on my décolletage. After a month, my skin is glowing.

 Your skin below the neck deserves just as much TLC as your face. These picks take your body care regimen to the next level with their high-performing formulas.
 “As a formulator, I can say this is one of the most interesting innovations in body care,” says cosmetic chemist Julie Pefferman. She loves this one for women living an active lifestyle since it helps manage odor without being harsh on your skin, including intimate areas.
 SHOP BLACK FRIDAY SKINCARE DEALS 
 Meanwhile, esthetician Sofie Pavitt calls the Soft Services Buff Body soap “the ultimate scrub bar for smooth-as-silk arms and legs.” Even better? “It also effectively removes keratosis pilaris,” she says.
 Dermatologist Kiran Mian, MD, advises wearing sunscreen daily to help protect your skin. This Blue Lizard SPF is her go-to body pick. It combines titanium dioxide and zinc oxide for broad-spectrum mineral coverage. Dr. Mian also appreciates the water resistant formula and that the sunscreen absorbs easily into her skin.

 Let’s face it. There are quite literally thousands of products out there and we can’t be the only ones who find it a tad overwhelming. Lucky for you, our team of experts did the hard work and curated a tightly edited list of impressive formulas that smooth and hydrate your complexion. These four are some of our favorites—and they happen to be up to 33 percent off.
 Face wash is an essential part of any skincare routine. Dermatologist Ryan Turner’s go-to for over-the-counter blemish control is from none other than CeraVe. It blends oil-absorbing kaolin clay with acne-reducing salicylic acid.
 SHOP BLACK FRIDAY SKINCARE DEALS 
 Noticed your makeup is looking a little patchy lately? “These SkinMedica pads are active yet gentle and help to lightly exfoliate for a smoother, more even complexion,” says celebrity makeup artist Gita Bass.
 Curious about Korean beauty products? Try BioDance, which combines peptides and collagen into a lightweight spray that blends like a dream. “You can spritz this on throughout the day to refresh your complexion without disturbing makeup,” says esthetician Cynthia Rivas. “It delivers a burst of hydration and radiance.”
 Your neck is one of the first spots to show the visible signs of aging. Underwood likes Olay’s targeted roller tip and formula that’s packed with NAD+ and a triple collagen peptide complex. “It delivers luxury skincare at an accessible price point,” he says.
